text:
deploybot: 🚫 deploy blocked — environment=staging, tag=release/v1.14.0-rc2, commit=9a8b7c3
deploybot: CI gate failed: schema-compat, e2e-integration, metrics-coverage. details: https://ci.example.com/builds/12345
Linh: on it, checking schema diff now
Alex: quick glance shows protobuf changes in PR #4822 not merged into the release branch
Sree: is #4822 the migration that changes user.profile schema? that would break older reads
Linh: yes — the migration landed on main but release branch missed it. schema-compat flagged protobuf diff: user.Profile changed (added optional field -> incompatible on our checks)
Marco: can we cherry-pick the migration into the RC? risk assessment?
Alex: risky, e2e also failing in unrelated flaky test `checkout-flow` — might be infra flake, but schema-compat is real
Sree: options: 1) merge migration into RC + rerun e2e, 2) pin back to last stable tag (v1.13.5) and abort RC, 3) delay change window and escalate to PMs
Linh: I can open a small PR with the missing proto change to the release branch. will run premerge locally then request CI rerun
ci-bot: rerun requested by Linh — queued (job id 5678)
deploybot: noted. deploy is on hold until rerun completes or we choose to pin. change window ends in ~90m
Alex: given the metrics-coverage drop and e2e flake, prefer to pin to stable for safety. If Linh's PR passes quickly we can try again after an out-of-band rollout
Marco: i'll prepare a rollback PR to pin release tag to `release/v1.13.5` and create a revert plan in the release board. cc @product-engineering
Linh: pulling the proto change into a hotfix PR now (WIP). if CI passes within 20m we can avoid pinning
Sree: either way, notify customer-support about potential delay. i'll draft a 1-line status for them
Alex: +1. also add a note to release notes about schema migration in case of visibility
deploybot: update: rerun failed — schema-compat still failing after hotfix build. e2e queued but coverage still below threshold
Marco: starting rollback/pin PR now. will tag and request manual approval for rollforward if needed
Linh: thx team — will follow up on the proto diff and open a postmortem if we find gaps in branch sync
ci-bot: job 5678 finished: e2e=flaky-fail, schema-compat=failed, coverage=drop
Sree: decision: pin to v1.13.5 for now, extend change window conversation to tomorrow. Marco to submit the PR and deploybot to run pinned deploy once approved
Marco: PR created: https://git.example.com/redwood/release/pulls/789 — title: pin-release-to-v1.13.5-due-to-schema-compat-fail
deploybot: acknowledged. holding deploy until PR merged + manual approval. will post final status when pinned deploy runs
Alex: thanks everyone, good call to avoid risky merge into RC. :thumbsup:
Linh: will follow up on synchronization process for release branches
